clues: This rural town in Panama sits just north of Panama City. It is made up of many small home areas that sit side by side.
It sits high up on the land, and that height gives it a cooler, more mild feel. This cool air sets it apart from low towns nearby.
This town was built up in the 1950s by a man named Louis Martinz. He was a business man who shaped its early growth.
This cool town drew many top people in Panama. Doctors, science workers, business chiefs, and state leaders all chose to make their homes here.
Look for two lakes that people built by hand in this town. They were made for play and sport, and to hold water for homes here.
